findings.evidence: The repository query and service implementation use one paged base/count query plus batched Plan and Tenant enrichment, and unit tests cover the bounded contract. No dedicated PostgreSQL fixture with at least 125 rows, EXPLAIN output, or measured query-count run was executed.
findings.why_it_matters: H2 and Mockito evidence does not prove PostgreSQL planner behavior, index usefulness, or the fixed query budget under the intended page sizes.
findings.required_action: Run the planned PostgreSQL page, ordering, filter, EXPLAIN and query-budget evidence in Phase07/release validation before making a production performance claim.

findings.evidence: The API client has generation-fenced refresh/replay tests and the web builds/typechecks pass, but no authenticated browser run inspected QueryCache, MutationCache, local/session storage, outgoing traces, or real authorization against a running backend.
findings.why_it_matters: Static and mocked checks cannot prove deployed role enforcement, browser persistence behavior, access-log redaction, or late callback behavior across a real account switch.
findings.required_action: Run the planned authenticated local/live browser and trace inspection with synthetic credentials and redacted bodies in Phase07/release validation.

findings.evidence: Phase06 implements bounded License pagination only. Global Applications/Plans pagination remains deferred until large-fixture request-size, render and accessibility measurements exist.
findings.why_it_matters: The current phase does not establish that every commercialization list needs the same pagination architecture or that the deferred lists meet a particular latency target.
findings.required_action: Measure the large Applications/Plans fixtures in Phase07 or open a separately scoped pagination decision if the measurements justify it.

scope_limit: Static senior review of the Phase06 API, secret boundary, repository batching, client/session lifecycle, vendor UI and documentation. Automated test and build results are recorded in the phase document. This approval does not substitute for PostgreSQL query/concurrency evidence, authenticated browser acceptance, production trace inspection or release approval.
